summary: No qualifying Dallas industrial sale comps were identified within 8 miles and 71,500–159,500 sf for 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. Most candidate records were updated by executed amendments to the Seattle market (U-R8490-6, U-R6997-4, U-R9929-5, U-R8382-7, U-R7274-9, U-R7218-8, U-R4189-10). The remaining Dallas candidates failed other required criteria (e.g., size, missing consideration, listing/portfolio/minority interest/redevelopment/related party), and one otherwise-qualifying sale (R7726) was published after the cutoff.
limitations: All conclusions rely solely on the provided base extracts and executed amendments effective on or before 2026-08-31; no external verification.
Entity-level amendments were applied across duplicate records per instruction; if amendments were record-specific, eligibility could differ.
Some records lacked consideration or had disqualifying scopes/conditions, reducing the pool of potential comps.
An otherwise-qualifying sale (R7726) was excluded due to publication timing after the cutoff.
